annotation.title_clean: “人工智能+”能源行动方案（国能发科技〔2026〕34号）
annotation.title_en: "AI+" Energy Action Plan (NEA Science and Technology [2026] No. 34)
named_instruments_referenced: State Council Opinions on Deepening the 'AI+' Action (Guofa [2025] No. 11)
annotation.summary_en: Chinese National Energy Administration action plan from April 2026 for using AI in the energy sector. It aims to give AI computing facilities clean energy supply, open high-value energy use cases, set up shared energy datasets, and reach world-leading levels by 2030. Funding comes through REITs, green bonds and finance channels. The excerpt contains nothing on robots.
key_provisions_or_claims: By 2027, build an initial secure, green and economic energy supply system for AI, with better interaction between clean energy and computing facilities
Set up a long-term system for jointly building and sharing high-quality energy datasets
By 2030, reach world-leading clean-energy supply for computing and world-leading energy-specific AI technology
Encourage computing facilities to apply for REITs and receive green finance and green bonds
Implements the State Council 'AI+' Action Opinions (Guofa [2025] No. 11)
